hero.heading: A private beach villa, fifty metres from the sea
hero.text: Three bedrooms, two of them en suite, and a nine metre pool of your own. Sleeps up to seven.
hero.alt: The private swimming pool at Villa Pergia, edged with flagstones, roses and an orange tree

about_text: Villa Pergia sits in the quiet coastal village of Latchi, on the edge of the Akamas peninsula. The beach is a two minute walk. Latchi harbour and the Baths of Aphrodite are both a five minute drive, and the Blue Lagoon is a morning boat trip away.

features.alt: The nine metre swimming pool with sun loungers and the pergola shaded terrace behind it
features.title: A nine metre private pool
features.text: Yours alone, with loungers, a shaded pergola and a barbecue on the terrace beside it.

features.alt: Open plan kitchen with a granite breakfast bar, bar stools and a dining table set for six
features.title: Open plan kitchen and dining
features.text: Dishwasher, washing machine, oven and hob, with a table for six and a breakfast bar.

features.alt: Double bedroom with a wooden bed frame, bedside tables and a window onto the garden
features.title: Three bedrooms, sleeping seven
features.text: One double and two twins. The two upstairs rooms are en suite, both opening onto balconies.

features.alt: The unspoilt sand and clear shallow water of Latchi beach
features.title: The beach, fifty metres away
features.text: Quiet and unspoilt. Loggerhead turtles nest along this stretch of coast in summer.

location_text: Petrou Christou 9, Neo Chorio, Paphos. Around an hour from Paphos airport and two hours from Larnaca.
